summary: validate-modules codes for unparsable removal versions, wrong requires extensions, missing doc fragments, documentation, examples, license, imports and interpreter lines.
questions: Why does validate-modules complain about the interpreter line?

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (missing items)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `invalid-removal-version`: can't parse (collections need semver)
- `invalid-requires-extension`: don't end `#AnsibleRequires`/`#Requires` with .cs/.psm1
- `missing-doc-fragment` / `missing-existing-doc-fragment`
- `missing-documentation`, `missing-examples`
- `missing-gplv3-license`: no GPLv3 header
- `missing-module-utils-basic-import` (warning), `missing-module-utils-import-csharp-requirements`
- `missing-python-interpreter` (`#!/usr/bin/python`), `missing-powershell-interpreter` (`#!powershell`)
